dedupe_keys.name: data for vanham et al sectoral water demand data for the year 2020 covering the african continent in high spatial resolution

description: Davy Vanham at the International Water Management Institute publishes African water-demand estimates centred on 2020, with companion 2010 layers. Sectors include municipal supply, irrigation, livestock, manufacturing, electricity and mining. The description identifies 46 crop classes, six livestock classes, 2,534 power plants and 682 mines. Excel summaries cover national, subnational and basin units; gridded outputs use 5 arcminutes, with selected municipal and manufacturing layers at 2.5 arcminutes. The February 2026 deposit provides eleven files free under CC BY 4.0. These estimates can connect sector demand to infrastructure-capacity and cross-sector water-allocation simulations. Resolution differs by product, so plant and mine points should not be interpreted as uniformly gridded observations. Estimation uncertainty and detailed units remain unknown from the landing summary. The provider asks users to use the latest version. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this package, and numerical files were not downloaded.
